name: Qiora
source: The queen of the magical kingdom of Milveria and one of the founders of Nirvana. She is gentle, thoughtful, and a pacifist, yet her concealed magic power is said to be the greatest in the continent. The magical barrier protecting the entire royal capital is deployed by her magic alone. Her power is largely attributed to her special lineage, which significantly slows her aging. Contrary to her appearance, rumors say she is beyond 100 years old. She always has Lan in her thoughts and guides her kindly.
